target_facts.old_spoken: Hands-free means voice-only with no touching, while covered devices span phones through laptops.
target_facts.statement: Iowa's hands-free rule forbids holding a phone or manually operating it while driving. Calls, texts and dialing require hands-free use or voice activation; video streaming and video calls remain prohibited even when voice-operated. Electronic devices include phones, personal digital assistants, tablets, gaming devices and laptops.

correction_input.corrected_statement: Under Iowa hands free law you must not hold or manually touch your phone and you may call text or dial only with hands free or voice activation but you must never stream videos or make video calls even with voice commands and covered electronic devices include cell phones PDAs tablets gaming devices and laptops.
correction_input.note: Added that video streaming and video calls stay banned even with voice commands.
